StoryMap.subtitle: Chagua sura uendelee na adventure yako

Parents.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Kwa Wazazi na Walimu
Parents.whatIsText: JamboScript ni programming language iliyotengenezwa kwa Kiswahili. Inafundisha basics za computer science kupitia stories na games — watoto wanajifunza kwa kufanya, si kusoma tu.
Parents.ageText: JamboScript imetengenezwa kwa watoto wa miaka 8–14. Hawahitaji kujua chochote mapema — game inawafundisha step by step.
Parents.safetyText: Code yote ina-run ndani ya browser tu — hakuna data inatumwa kwa server yoyote. Hakuna ads, hakuna tracking, hakuna hidden charges.

ch1.title: Amri za Kwanza
ch1.subtitle: Jifunze kutoa amri za kwanza
ch1.d1: Kwa kijiji cha Algoriti, kuna gate kubwa imefungwa na uchawi. Unahitaji kusema maneno sahihi ili uifungue...
ch1.d2: Sasa! Mimi ni Kito 🐢. Ona hii gate — imefungwa! Ili uifungue, lazima computer "iseme" maneno kwa sauti.
ch1.d3: "andika" ni command ya kwanza ya JamboScript — inaambia computer: "sema hii kwa sauti!" Jaribu:
ch1.d4: andika(...) = show output nje. Maneno ndani ya "..." ndio yanaonyeshwa. Gate itafunguka ukisema maneno!
ch1.task: Andika command ya kufungua gate ya kijiji
ch1.riddle: 🚪 Gate imefungwa na uchawi. Sema maneno sahihi uifungue!
ch1.hint1: Tumia neno "andika" ikifuatiwa na mabano na maneno ndani
ch1.hint3: Hakikisha unatumia quote marks " " kuzunguka maneno

ch2.title: Hifadhi na Majina
ch2.subtitle: Jifunze kutumia variables
ch2.d1: Gate imefunguka! Mlinzi wa kijiji amesimama hapo, mkuki mkononi. Anauliza: "Jina lako nani?"
ch2.d2: Mlinzi hatakuacha upite bila kujua jina lako! Tunahitaji "ku-save" jina kwenye memory ya computer.
ch2.d3: "acha" ni kama box — unaweka kitu ndani na kuipatia jina. Save jina lako hivi:
ch2.d4: "acha jina = ..." = computer ikumbuke. "andika(jina)" = sema jina kwa sauti — mlinzi atasikia na atakuacha upite!
ch2.starterCode:
# Save jina lako hapa

acha jina = ""

# Kisha sema jina lako
andika(jina)
ch2.riddle: 🏠 Mlinzi anauliza: "Jina lako nani?" — Save jina lako kwenye variable!
ch2.hint1: Badilisha "" na jina lako ndani ya quote marks
ch2.hint3: Hakikisha jina lina herufi angalau moja ndani ya ""
ch2.errorNoName: Save jina lako — andika jina ndani ya quote marks!

ch3.title: Kama... Basi...
ch3.subtitle: Jifunze kufanya decisions
ch3.d1: Safari inakupeleka msituni. Mbele yako njia imegawanyika — kushoto ni pango, kulia ni mto...
ch3.d2: Karibu msituni, mdogo 🧙. Ona — njia mbili! Lazima uchague kulingana na weather.
ch3.d3: Computer inaweza kufanya decisions! "kama" = check condition, "la sivyo" = the other option:
ch3.d4: Mvua? → pango salama 🕳️. Jua? → mto mzuri 🏞️. "kama" ni kama brain — ina-check condition, kisha inachagua!
ch3.task: Chagua njia sahihi kulingana na weather
ch3.riddle: 🌧️ Mvua au jua? Chagua njia sahihi kwa weather!
ch3.hint1: "kama" ni same na "if" — check condition ndani ya mabano
ch3.hint3: "la sivyo" ni same na "else" — the other option

ch4.title: Rudia Tena
ch4.subtitle: Jifunze ku-repeat commands
ch4.d1: Mbele yako kuna daraja la kamba juu ya mto. Ona mbao 5 — lazima uvuke step moja kwa moja...
ch4.d2: Daraja hii ni dhaifu! Mbao 5 tu. Piga step moja kwa moja — lakini si lazima uandike command mara 5!
ch4.d3: "rudia" ni command yenye nguvu — inasema "fanya hii mara 5" kwa line moja! Angalia:
ch4.d4: Methali: "Hatua moja kwa moja, safari inakamilika." Tumia loop kuvuka!
ch4.task: Tumia loop kutembea steps 5 kuvuka daraja
ch4.riddle: 🌉 Daraja la kamba — steps 5 tu. Tumia "rudia" kutembea safely!
ch4.hint1: "rudia" ni same na "for" — inarepeat commands many times
ch4.hint2: Anza na i = 0, repeat wakati i chini 5, i++ kila mara
ch4.hint3: Ndani ya {}, andika command ya kutembea

ch5.title: Kazi Zangu
ch5.subtitle: Jifunze ku-create functions
ch5.d1: Umefika juu ya mlima! Hapa, wahusika wanajifunza ku-create uchawi wao — functions...
ch5.d2: Ona hii box ya uchawi! "kazi" ni kama machine — unai-create mara moja, kisha unai-use mara nyingi. Ipe kitu, iku-return jibu!
ch5.d3: "kazi" = create uchawi mpya. "rudisha" = return jibu. Ipe 7, i-return mara mbili:
ch5.d4: Box inapokea 7, inazidisha × 2, inarudisha 14. Hiyo ndio "kazi" — uchawi wa ku-return jibu! Jaribu.
ch5.task: Create function inayozidisha number mara mbili
ch5.riddle: ⛰️ Mlimani, uchawi unakuzidisha! Create function ya "maraMbili" — ipe number, i-return mara mbili!
ch5.hint1: "kazi" ni same na "function" — ku-create uchawi mpya
ch5.errorWrongAnswer: Jibu inapaswa kuwa 14, lakini umepata jibu lingine
